name: instructions
help:
usage: work instructions [-h]
                            {catalog,resolve,load,select,impact,recover} ...

positional arguments:
  {catalog,resolve,load,select,impact,recover}

options:
  -h, --help            Return command help in a JSON response.

children.name: catalog
children.help:
usage: work instructions catalog --mode {task,execute,all}

Retired: Host discovery is required; Work validates explicit formal instruction selections.

children.name: resolve
children.help:
usage: work instructions resolve [-h] --mode {task,execute}
                                    [paths ...]

positional arguments:
  paths

options:
  -h, --help            Return command help in a JSON response.
  --mode {task,execute}

children.name: load
children.help:
usage: work instructions load [-h] --mode {task,execute}
                                 [--reference REFERENCE]
                                 [paths ...]

positional arguments:
  paths

options:
  -h, --help            Return command help in a JSON response.
  --mode {task,execute}
  --reference REFERENCE

children.name: select
children.help:
usage: work instructions select [-h] --mode {task,execute}
                                   [--reference REFERENCE]
                                   [paths ...]

positional arguments:
  paths

options:
  -h, --help            Return command help in a JSON response.
  --mode {task,execute}
  --reference REFERENCE

children.name: impact
children.help:
usage: work instructions impact [-h]

options:
  -h, --help  Return command help in a JSON response.

children.name: recover
children.help: usage: work instructions recover [-h] --journal-path JOURNAL_PATH --approved-sha256 APPROVED_SHA256
